goal: Catch flaky verification descriptors before enrollment consumes QA rounds: enrollment readiness runs a bounded, read-only concurrency rehearsal of the intent's verification descriptors and reports per-descriptor timing, so default timeouts and fixture leaks surface while the intent is still a draft.

acceptance.assertion: Enrollment readiness executes each verification descriptor's canonical argv in parallel isolated copies bounded by the descriptor timeouts, performs zero authority writes and zero worktree mutation, reports per-descriptor pass/fail with timing, and marks enrollment_ready false with an actionable reason when a descriptor fails or exhibits timeout flakiness under concurrency; the explicit waiver enrollment route can override a rehearsal failure only through literal-user confirmation and records the override in the enrollment receipt.
Enrollment readiness documentation, command output, and contract tests consistently describe the rehearsal check and its waiver semantics across source and packaged artifacts.
The complete Pi extension graph passes strict TypeScript checking and the full repository test suite passes with no regressions.
